_note: Available Accessories table (manual L1187-L1203) + one-line mechanical effect from each item's description section. kinds: guidance (L1208-L1294), defense (L1299-L1374), misc (L1384-L1401).

accessories.name: Heat Guidance
accessories.effect: Heat detector guides the weapon in a straight line to any enemy tank once in range.

accessories.name: Ballistic Guidance
accessories.effect: Computes the power to hit a chosen target at your current angle; corrects any wind, not air viscosity; fires randomly if the shot is impossible.

accessories.name: Horizontal Guidance
accessories.effect: Sends the weapon in a horizontal straight line once even with the chosen target.

accessories.name: Vertical Guidance
accessories.effect: Once the warhead is above the chosen target, it heads straight down to it.

accessories.name: Lazy Boy
accessories.effect: Ultimate guidance: hits the chosen target; explodes prematurely if it hits another tank first.

accessories.name: Parachute
accessories.effect: Deployed before a damaging fall (threshold default 5) so the tank takes no fall damage.

accessories.name: Battery
accessories.effect: Energy source: one battery recharges 10% of tank energy (10 pts) or powers Plasma Blasts.

accessories.name: Mag Deflector
accessories.effect: Exerts upward force on nearby projectiles over the tank; fails on fast falls, absorbs few hits.

accessories.name: Shield
accessories.effect: Absorbs explosion damage; a direct hit does not explode but slightly damages the shield.

accessories.name: Force Shield
accessories.effect: Deflects projectiles away; sustains more damage than a normal shield.

accessories.name: Heavy Shield
accessories.effect: Immune to shield failures; sustains tremendous damage.

accessories.name: Super Mag
accessories.effect: Best shield: stronger than Heavy, immune to lasers, carries Mag Deflector side effects.

accessories.name: Auto Defense
accessories.effect: Lets you enable any defense system each round pre-combat; one-time cost scaled to rounds left.

accessories.name: Fuel Tank
accessories.effect: Each tank gives 10 fuel units; 1 unit moves the tank 1 pixel (less uphill).

accessories.name: Armor
accessories.effect: Bolt-on plating: while ON it absorbs half of all incoming damage; TOGGLEABLE per player (hotkey V). Toggle ON shows the tank model's Armor1-4 plating nodes.
accessories._source: _placeholder — armor is NOT in the manual L1185-L1204 accessory table; cost/bundle/armsLevel/absorption unpinned (W2-C-sibling user directive)

accessories.name: Contact Trigger
accessories.effect: Projectile explodes the moment it touches something (tunneling off); one trigger covers all warheads of a multi-warhead shot.

laws._source: Accessory numeric laws. Manual describes behaviors, never percentages (shield L1346-L1366, battery L1332-L1337, parachute threshold IS manual-pinned L1194 default 5). Armor is NOT in the manual (L1185-L1204) — declared pin.
laws._note: fuelTankUnits: manual:L1388-L1392 pins each fuel tank = 10 units.
